name: Divided Highway Ends
spec: yellow diamond with two black arrows joining after a black island
meaning: The divided highway ends; two-way traffic ahead.

snippets.back: Warning signs alert drivers to two-way traffic ahead, merging traffic, right-lane reductions, upcoming roundabouts, divided highways ahead, and divided highway ends—where the divided roadway ends three hundred fifty to five hundred feet ahead before two-way traffic resumes.

Most warning signs are yellow diamonds carrying a black border and black symbols or words, and the examples pictured include divided highway, divided highway ends, hill, slippery when wet, pedestrian crossing, and lane ends or road narrows.
A Divided Highway Ends sign warns that opposing traffic will no longer be separated by a center strip.
A Divided Highway Ends sign means the divided road becomes two lanes of traffic, and a Two-Way Traffic sign means two-way traffic begins, so keep right.
A divided highway begins sign tells you to stay right as the road divides, while a divided highway ends sign warns that two-way traffic will no longer be separated by a center island.
A Divided Highway Ends warning means the road becomes a single roadway carrying traffic both ways, where drivers should keep right.
Divided Highway Ends warns that a median will no longer separate opposing traffic and directs drivers to keep right.
DIVIDED HIGHWAY ENDS warns of a return to two-way traffic, requiring a position right of the centerline and attention to oncoming vehicles.
